mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals economic weakness prompting expected Federal Reserve rate cuts, which drive positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of months with UNRATE > 4.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production signals improving supply chain efficiency and economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 55% of early-cycle expansion periods with INDPRO rising, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, causing short-term equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 2.5%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 55% of instances with PAYEMS rising, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising and CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, the market overreacts to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL 12m yoy > 2.5%, or the interaction Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-housing boom regime, declining housing starts signal a cooling housing sector, reducing economic growth momentum and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with HOUST below its 6-month moving average in a post-housing boom regime, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
